beverloo_fit — DRIVE granular op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.beverloo_fit(D0, W, d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'dict' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import granular; granular.beverloo_fit(D0, W, d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'dict', registry से लेना हो तो opsdrive.get("beverloo_fit"))

उपयोग

discharge rates की series W_i(D0_i) पर log W = log(C ρ_b √g) + n log(D₀ − k d) को least squares से fit करके exponent n और coefficient C लौटाता है (ground truth n = 2.5, C ≈ 0.58)। return: n, C, rms_log (log residual)। Raises ValueError: 3 से कम बिंदु / D0 ≤ k d वाला बिंदु / W ≤ 0।
